name: ODSOFilters
description: Represents all the filters to apply to the data source attached to the mail merge publication. The ODSOFilters object is composed of ODSOFilter objects.
remarks: Use the Add method of the ODSOFilters object to add a new filter criterion to the query.
example:
Sub SetQueryCriterion()
 Dim appOffice As OfficeDataSourceObject

 Set appOffice = Application.OfficeDataSourceObject
 appOffice.Open bstrConnect:="DRIVER=SQL Server;SERVER=ServerName;" & _
 "UID=user;PWD=;DATABASE=Northwind", bstrTable:="Employees"

 With appOffice.Filters
 .Add Column:="Region", _
 Comparison:=msoFilterComparisonIsBlank, _
 Conjunction:=msoFilterConjunctionAnd
 .ApplyFilter
 End With
End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the ODSOFilters object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the ODSOFilters object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the ODSOFilters collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the ODSOFilters object. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Represents an ODSOFilter object in the ODSOFilters collection.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Column As String, Comparison As MsoFilterComparison, Conjunction As MsoFilterConjunction, [bstrCompareTo As String], [DeferUpdate As Boolean])
methods.description: Adds a new filter to the ODSOFilters collection.

parameters.name: Column
parameters.description: The name of the table in the data source.

parameters.name: Comparison
parameters.description: How the data in the table is filtered.

parameters.name: Conjunction
parameters.description: Determines how this filter relates to other filters in the ODSOFilters object.

parameters.name: bstrCompareTo
parameters.description: If the _Comparison_ argument is something other than msoFilterComparisonIsBlank or msoFilterComparisonIsNotBlank, _bstrCompareTo_ is a string to which the data in the table is compared.

parameters.name: DeferUpdate
parameters.description: Specifies whether to delay updating the filter. Default is False.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a filter object from the ODSOFilters collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The number of the filter to delete.

parameters.name: DeferUpdate
parameters.description: Specifies whether to delay updating the filter. Default is False.
